facts.claim: DARPA independently lists Infleqtion as a performer on the Mosaic portion of the Heterogeneous Architectures for Quantum (HARQ) program.
facts.whyItMatters: This independently corroborates issuer-reported participation in HARQ and supports the existence of a real government-backed heterogeneous-quantum development pathway without relying on issuer or SEC-origin reporting.

facts.claim: DARPA describes HARQ as a 24-month co-design effort intended to establish architectural principles, tools and components for heterogeneous quantum systems and larger-scale future demonstrations.
facts.whyItMatters: This supports a bounded execution/catalyst interpretation: INFQ has independent program validation, while scaled operational capability remains a future program objective rather than a completed commercial outcome.

risks.risk: DARPA performer status validates participation, not commercial economics, revenue realization, technical success, or achievement of Infleqtion's separate logical-qubit roadmap.

unknowns.unknown: The DARPA page does not independently establish INFQ contract value, revenue recognition, margins, or customer economics.

recommendation: Reuse this independent DARPA origin as source-integrity/catalyst corroboration, then continue Alpha-owned numeric underwriting from source-addressed financial evidence. Do not infer score values from this artifact alone.
